{{Quote|Escaped from domestic service on Nal Hutta.|B'inka Fibuna's bounty brief|<ref name="BH" />}}
'''B'inka Fibuna''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who, with the help of the [[Freedom Convoy]], escaped from her [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] from [[Ka'Pa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. After the escape in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], she hid on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] turned her over to the authorities during his pursuit of the [[Slythmonger/Legends|drug dealer]] [[Jervis Gloom]].

==Biography==
B'inka Fibuna was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="BHguide" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Ryloth">{{SWE|locations|ryloth|Ryloth}}</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="BHguide" /> She was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the<ref name="CSWEFibuna" /> [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Ka'Pa">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031106hutt|text=Hutt! Hutt! Hutt! #5}}</ref> [[Ka'Pa]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]<ref name="CSWEFibuna" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, which includes the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> While enslaved, she was forced to work as a dancer in Ka'Pa's estate on<ref name="CSWEFibuna" /> the world<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. Fibuna discovered the [[Freedom Convoy]],<ref name="CSWEFibuna" /> a group that had launched a campaign to free Twi'lek women from Hutt enslavement<ref name="CSWEFreedom">{{CSWECite|I|294|Freedom Convoy}}</ref> and escaped with their help shortly after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] blockade on<ref name="CSWEFibuna" /> the planet<ref name="Naboo">{{SWE|locations|naboo|Naboo}}</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was broken.<ref name="CSWEFibuna" /> 

After the escape, Ka'Pa posted a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the woman for 3,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. It listed her last known locations as [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] along core [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] and her affiliates as [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the Freedom Convoy.<ref name="BH" /> Fibuna fled to the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she tried to stay out of the public [[Eye/Legends|eye]] in<ref name="CSWEFibuna" /> the world's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]. When the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] visited the district, searching for [[Slythmonger/Legends|drug dealer]] [[Jervis Gloom]], the Twi'lek danced alone<ref name="BH" /> on a viewing platform.<ref name="BHguide" /> Fett encountered the woman, who cowered in fear as he moved towards her. The bounty hunter entangled her with his [[Whipcord launcher/Legends|whipcord]]<ref name="BH" /> and turned her into the authorities, but not before collecting the bounty on her.<ref name="CSWEFibuna" />

==Personality and traits==
Fibuna possessed [[Color/Legends|brown]] eyes and yellow skin that was striped with orange.<ref name="BH" /> She tried her best to stay hidden on Coruscant, but unfortunately for her, she was found by Jango Fett.<ref name="CSWEFibuna" />

==Equipment==
The Twi'lek wore a silver headdress and a [[Clothing/Legends|bodysuit]] colored like her skin tone.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Do not harm this Twi'lek! Mark from the connecting bridge, and simply walk up to her and snare.|The recommended take down tactic for B'inka Fibuna in ''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide|<ref name="BHguide" />}}
[[File:BountyHunter-Cover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The cover of ''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'', which featured the first appearance of B'inka Fibuna.]]
B'inka Fibuna first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', a [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[LucasArts]]. In the game's bounty viewer, and in the game's accompanying [[Prima Games]] strategy guide written by [[David Hodgson]], the character is incorrectly portrayed as pale-skinned and wearing black clothing.<ref name="BH" /><ref name="BHguide" /> The game was released on [[November 22]], 2002,<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> and the guide was published four days later on [[November 26]].<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=Bounty-Hunter-Primas-Official-Strategy/dp/0761541640|text=Star Wars Bounty Hunter (Prima's Official Strategy Guide)}}</ref> Fibuna's character model shares similarities with the [[prequel trilogy]] character [[Ayy Vida/Legends|Ayy Vida]], such as having the same skin tone, eye color, and clothing as the character.<ref name="BH" /><ref name="DB">{{DB|character|ayyvida|Vida, Ayy}}</ref>

Fibuna's capture by Fett, which was the optional first bounty in the entertainment district level,<ref name="BHguide" /> was confirmed in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWEFibuna" /> The game also gave the player the option of killing the woman, though this provides the player with no credits<ref name="BHguide" /> and was made [[Canon|non-canonical]] in the aforementioned book.<ref name="CSWEFibuna" />
